name: Shatter / dismemberment

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. A violent frozen bone fracture and dense crunchy break, followed by a broad long cascade of sharp ice splinters bouncing, scattering and tinkling. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
